rem Prime Subset Sums
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=249
rem Count the subsets of the primes
rem below Limit whose sum is prime,
rem modulo Mod

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Limit integer = 5000
arg Mod integer = 10000000000000000

rem Count the subsets by sum with the
rem usual knapsack table, adding each
rem prime in turn and sweeping the sums
rem downward.
Ps = primes till Limit array
Max = Ps sum
Ways = array shape (Max + 1) fill 0
Ways 0 = 1
Top = 0
for P in Ps
  Top += P
  for S in Top to P by -1
    From = Ways (S - P)
    Ways S = (Ways S + From) mod Mod
  end
end
Pr = primes till (Max + 1) array
Answer = (Ways Pr) sum mod Mod
Answer print

rem Prime Subset Sums
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=249
rem Count the subsets of the primes
rem below Limit whose sum is prime,
rem modulo Mod

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Limit integer = 5000
arg Mod integer = 10000000000000000

rem Count the subsets by sum with the
rem usual knapsack table, adding each
rem prime in turn and sweeping the sums
rem downward.
Ps = primes till Limit array
Max = Ps sum
Answer = 0
Low = Mod // 2
High = Mod - Low
if Mod greater 0 and High at most 9007199254740991
  Ways = Ps subset_counts Max Low High
  Pr = primes till (Max + 1) array
  Answer = (Ways Pr) sum mod Mod
else
  Ways = array shape (Max + 1) fill 0
  Ways 0 = 1
  Top = 0
  for P in Ps
    Top += P
    for S in Top to P by -1
      From = Ways (S - P)
      Ways S = (Ways S + From) mod Mod
    end
  end
  Pr = primes till (Max + 1) array
  Answer = (Ways Pr) sum mod Mod
end
Answer print

rem Store residues in [-Low, High). Move
rem across Mod = Low + High before adding,
rem keeping every intermediate exact in
rem Number. Larger moduli use BigInt above.
fun Ps subset_counts Max Low High
  Ways = array shape (Max + 1) fill 0
  Ways 0 = 1
  if High equal 1
    Ways 0 = 0 - Low
  end
  Top = 0
  for P in Ps
    Top += P
    for S in Top to P by -1
      Value = Ways S
      From = Ways (S - P)
      if From at least 0
        if Value at least High - From
          Value -= High
          From -= Low
        end
      else
        if Value less (0 - Low) - From
          Value += Low
          From += High
        end
      end
      Ways S = Value + From
    end
  end
  return Ways
end

use cli

arg Limit integer = 5000
arg Mod integer = 10000000000000000

rem Count the subsets by sum with the
rem usual knapsack table, adding each
rem prime in turn and sweeping the sums
rem downward.
Ps = primes till Limit array
Max = Ps sum
Answer = 0
Base = Mod gcd 100000000
if Mod greater 0 and Mod // Base at most 100000000
  Counts = Ps subset_counts Max Base (Mod // Base)
  Pr = primes till (Max + 1) array
  Lo = Counts 0
  Hi = Counts 1
  Lower = (Lo Pr) sum
  Upper = (Hi Pr) sum
  Answer = (Upper * Base + Lower) mod Mod
else
  Ways = array shape (Max + 1) fill 0
  Ways 0 = 1
  Top = 0
  for P in Ps
    Top += P
    for S in Top to P by -1
      From = Ways (S - P)
      Ways S = (Ways S + From) mod Mod
    end
  end
  Pr = primes till (Max + 1) array
  Answer = (Ways Pr) sum mod Mod
  
end
Answer print

rem Keep bounded digits in a private table;
rem combine them exactly after the search.
fun Ps subset_counts Max Base HighMod
  Ways = array shape 2 (Max + 1) fill 0
  Ways 0 0 = 1 mod Base
  Ways 1 0 = (1 // Base) mod HighMod
  Top = 0
  for P in Ps
    Top += P
    for S in Top to P by -1
      L = Ways 0 S + Ways 0 (S - P)
      H = Ways 1 S + Ways 1 (S - P)
      if L at least Base
        L -= Base
        H += 1
      end
      if H at least HighMod
        H -= HighMod
      end
      Ways 0 S = L
      Ways 1 S = H
    end
  end
  return Ways
end

fun Ps subset_counts Max Half
  Ways = array shape (Max + 1) fill 0
  Ways 0 = 1
  if Half equal 1
    Ways 0 = -1
  end
  Top = 0
  for P in Ps
    Top += P
    for S in Top to P by -1
      Value = Ways S
      From = Ways (S - P)

          From -= Half

      else
        if Value less (0 - Half) - From
          Value += Half
          From += Half
        end
      end
      Ways S = Value + From
    end
  end

end
